purpose: Bounded disclosure and ZIP member-safety review of exact new raw text reports selected for public Git publication
listing_definition: SHA-256 of lexicographically sorted UTF-8 lines: <raw_file_SHA256> <byte_size> <artifact-relative-path>\n, across four extracted source artifact directories

screening.path_fragments: Only routine GitHub Actions /home/runner and ephemeral /tmp test fixtures; no /Users, /root or project-local user workspace paths

scope_limitations: Does not authorize republication of whole new ZIPs, excluded large source reports, or any new binary evidence payload.
Static patterns are a bounded content review, not proof of universal absence of sensitive information.
Original bytes must remain unchanged; retain artifact ZIP/member hashes and expiration dates.
